title: wss-guide: client typing section omits receiveTypingIndicators client-side behavior
description: In jmap-chat-wss-guide.md, the 'Handling typing indicators' client implementation section makes no mention of receiveTypingIndicators. A first-time client implementor reading this section will wonder: should the client suppress Chat/typing calls when the local Chat record has receiveTypingIndicators: false? Should the client read this field before calling Chat/typing? The spec says suppression is server-enforced and Chat/typing always succeeds from the sender's perspective regardless of the recipient's preference — but the guide never explains this. A short note clarifying that receiveTypingIndicators is a server-side delivery preference (not a client-side send gate) would prevent implementors from incorrectly checking it before calling Chat/typing.
close_reason: Fixed in review fix wave or recorded as accepted design decision.
